scenarios.title: x402 #3854 SVM Batch-Settlement Post-Commit Operation Completion
scenarios.reason: PASS: SVM batch operations completed strictly after channel charge committed outside update callback (x402 #3854).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: SVM batch operations marked complete inside ChannelStore.update callback before channel charge committed (x402 #3854).

scenarios.title: x402 #3848 Recovery Extension Fail-Closed Settled-Replay Guard
scenarios.reason: PASS: Recovery extension verified confirmed settlement and matching request/response hashes (x402 #3848).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: Free replay granted on non-confirmed settlement status 'pending' violating fail-closed recovery rule (x402 #3848).

scenarios.title: x402 #3843 EVM Permit2 Signature-Check RPC Outage Disambiguation
scenarios.reason: PASS: Permit2 signature verified cleanly with distinct RPC failure reporting (x402 #3843).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: Facilitator RPC outage during Permit2 check misreported as forged signature 'invalid_permit2_signature' instead of 'invalid_permit2_failed_to_verify_signature' (x402 #3843).

scenarios.title: x402 #3840 SIWX Payment Server Request Path Binding
scenarios.reason: PASS: SIWX payment recorded and verified strictly against server request path (x402 #3840).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: SIWX payment recorded under '/v2/premium-inference' (client resource.url 'https://api.example.com/v2/premium-inference') instead of server request path '/v2/cheap-ping', enabling cross-route privilege escalation (x402 #3840).

scenarios.title: x402 #3834 & #3826 Fastify Non-JSON Body & 402 Extensions Immutability
scenarios.reason: PASS: Non-JSON settlement body sent as-is and 402 extensions shallow-cloned without mutating declaredExtensions (x402 #3834, #3826).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: Non-JSON string settlement body (text/plain) was double-quoted via JSON.stringify in Fastify onSend hook (x402 #3834).

scenarios.title: x402 #3828 & #3825 V2 Atomic-Unit Digit Format & Go SettleError HTTP 200
scenarios.reason: PASS: V2 atomic-unit amount format verified and wrapped SettleError preserved on HTTP 200 SettleResponse (x402 #3828, #3825).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: Client silently rounded or rescaled an invalid payment amount instead of failing validation (x402 #3828).

scenarios.reason: PASS: Order schema is free of directional request annotations and catalog search purpose/reference_ids are valid (UCP #903, #902).

scenarios.reason: PASS: Purchase option selection preserved onto Order line and Food Checkout fulfillment constraints satisfied (UCP #901, #897).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: selected_purchase_option_id 'opt_sub_annual_unlisted' is not in variant purchase_options ['opt_once'] (UCP #901).

scenarios.title: UCP #891 & #876 RFC 9728 Exact Issuer Match & DNS-Delegated Email Linking
scenarios.reason: PASS: RFC 9728 authorization_servers issuer matches RFC 8414 metadata and email linking obeys DNS-delegated authority rule (UCP #891, #876).

scenarios.title: UCP #900, #883 & #882 Conformance Corpus, MCP Complete Extensions & Self-Hosting
scenarios.reason: PASS: Exported conformance corpus validated, MCP complete_checkout extensions declared, and vendor extensions self-hosted (UCP #900, #883, #882).

scenarios.title: MCP Py-SDK #3742 & #3741 Stdio JSON-RPC Error Frame & HTTP ReadTimeout Isolation
scenarios.reason: PASS: Unparseable stdio lines receive JSON-RPC error frames and HTTP ReadTimeouts are isolated to the timed-out request task (mcp-py #3742, #3741).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: Unparseable stdio line dropped as bare exception instead of returning a JSON-RPC error frame on the wire, hanging the client (mcp-py #3742).

scenarios.title: MCP Py-SDK #3740 & #3734 Reserved Param Prefix Collision & Sync Prompt Awaitable
scenarios.reason: PASS: Reserved tool parameter prefixing avoids field collisions and sync prompt awaitables are properly awaited (mcp-py #3740, #3734).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: Tool parameter shadowing ArgModelBase attribute collided with another prefixed parameter name (mcp-py #3740).

scenarios.title: MCP Py-SDK #3739 & #3730 OAuth RFC 8707 Resource Indicator & RFC 7519 Exact Expiry
scenarios.reason: PASS: RFC 8707 resource indicator preserved in token exchange and RFC 7519 strict '<' expiry enforced (mcp-py #3739, #3730).
scenarios.attack_reason: REJECT: OAuth token exchange dropped RFC 8707 resource indicator 'https://mcp.merchant.example/tools' (mcp-py #3739).

scenarios.title: MCP Py-SDK #3726, #3724 & #3719 SSE Header Copy, URI Surrogateescape & Skills Cache Gate
scenarios.reason: PASS: SSE header lists isolated, URI octets preserved via surrogateescape, and directory cache fields gated on 2026-07-28+ (mcp-py #3726, #3724, #3719).

scenarios.reason: PASS: Same-item exchanges rejected, empty MMSC URL treated as unconfigured, and gold actions matched 1-to-1 (tau2 #667, #666, #665).
